name: Athena Foods
old_description: We are a family owned and operated food manufacturer, serving the Metro-Detroit restaurant industry since 1989! We pride ourselves on producing top quality, delicious foods made using only the finest, all-natural ingredients, without the use of any preservatives! We offer both individually portioned and party-sized products which are fully cooked and frozen, only requiring reheating. This makes our product a quick, convenient alternative! Our facility is USDA and FDA inspected, ensuring the safe handling of all products.
about:
Athena Foods is a family-owned food manufacturer based in Southfield, Michigan, that has served the Metro-Detroit restaurant industry since 1989. The company was founded as a family operation and remains under family ownership today.

The company produces fully cooked, frozen food items using all-natural ingredients and no preservatives. Its product line includes individually portioned servings (12 oz, packed 24 or 32 per case) and party-sized trays (6 lb, packed 2 or 6 per case) that only require reheating, offering a quick and convenient alternative for foodservice operators. Production takes place in a USDA- and FDA-inspected facility where items are cooked, portioned, frozen, and packaged.

Athena Foods primarily supplies restaurants in the Metro-Detroit area. Its portioned and tray products are designed for foodservice use, though specific customer names are not disclosed.

The business emphasizes its commitment to quality through all-natural ingredients, the absence of preservatives, and the convenience of ready-to-heat formats. The family-owned structure is cited as a foundation for consistent product standards.
